name: Kanuchi - Shiroki Tsubasa no Shou
original_name: カヌチ 白き翼の章
source:
Two thousand years ago, there were two big families, Takamahara and Yasuna, who fought against each other for a long time. One day, Kayana from Takamahara and Izusami from Yasuna fell in love. It was, however, strictly prohibited and they got forcibly separated.... Several years later, a huge battle between two families broke out. Kayana and Izusami also had a one-on-one battle and Kayana finally won.... Today, Kayana comes back to life. She, however, can't have a body, so she enters into Aki's body....

[Edited from Himeya Shop]
translation:
两千年前，高天原与安那两大族群长期争斗。一天，高天原的迦耶那与安那的伊邪佐海坠入爱河。然而，这段感情被严格禁止，两人遭到强行拆散…数年后，两族爆发大战。迦耶那与伊邪佐海也展开了一对一决战，最终由迦耶那获胜…时至今日，迦耶那复活了。但她无法拥有自己的身体，只得进入亚纪体内…

[编辑自Himeya Shop]
